title: Global Existence of Classical Solutions to Brenner-Navier-Stokes-Fourier System for Large Data
summary: We study the 1D Brenner-Navier-Stokes-Fourier (BNSF) system, proposed as a refinement of the classical Navier--Stokes--Fourier model through the introduction of the volume velocity, distinct from the mass velocity describing convective transport. When formulated in the Lagrangian mass coordinates with the volume velocity, the discrepancy between the two velocities induces a dissipative structure in the mass conservation law.
